duplicate_rule: Remove only rows identical across all substantive non-outcome fields; repeated student-course keys are retained unless fully identical.
nplay_video_rule: Convert derived-file placeholder 197757 to missing and retain an availability indicator; never equate missing with zero.
age_rule: Treat age <= 0 or > 100 as missing; do not impute before EDA or clustering-feature selection.
date_rule: Parse with coercion; flag last-event dates earlier than start dates and preserve their span as missing.
categorical_rule: Trim text and use an explicit Unknown category for missing categorical values.
aggregation_rule: Aggregate valid person-course records to one row per userid_DI using field-appropriate count, sum, mean, maximum, median, or mode operations.
